title: l9-meta-injector.local-files-extraction/v2 ownership marker
description: The exact provenance marker a materialized extraction directory carries. Destructive replacement requires this complete v2 shape and matching archive basename; legacy, partial, or foreign markers never authorize removal.

archive.description: Basename of the archive that owns this sibling extraction target.

archive_sha256.description: Digest of the exact immutable staged archive bytes this extraction was produced from.

reader_version.description: Canonical ZIP reader version that produced the admission verdict.

policy_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the resolved semantic archive policy used for admission.

created_at.description: When the verified candidate completed, ISO 8601.
